_comment: SLA-aware criticality routing. The model judges CONTENT only (one SLA-blind noul -> raw probability per ticket). SLA is business metadata applied as a per-ticket threshold, NOT sent to the model. Identical content under different SLA -> same p, different route.

question.name: service_impacting
question.instructions: Does this message describe an active, service-impacting problem (something broken, failing, or blocking the customer) right now? Judge only by concrete impact stated in the message, not by tone or politeness.

criteria.true: An error, outage, failure, data loss, or blocked workflow is actively happening
criteria.false: A question, feature request, cosmetic nit, praise, or anything with a clear workaround

sla_cuts._doc: Per-SLA (critical_at, review_at) cut points on the raw probability p. Lower cut = fires on weaker signal = stricter SLA escalates more readily. p>=critical -> page; p>=review -> human queue; else routine.
